scientific_integrity: Self-review only. No independent audit, priority certification, or numerical-to-infinite inference is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Requires the intersection of a Euclidean ball or ellipsoid with two parallel closed halfspaces, with nonempty interior.
The golden-ratio upper endpoint is a supremum only; it is not attained by a full-dimensional slab.
The fixed-upper-cut envelope is proved for upper level strictly between zero and one.
Historical priority remains provisional; unindexed special-case formulas may exist.
Finite polygonal numerical checks corroborate but do not establish the continuum theorem.
title: Sharp Minkowski asymmetry and golden-ratio envelope of Euclidean ball slabs
